tolerance_budget.limits: Body surface error and finished pin/bore limits are design assumptions. Factory capability, coatings, dirt, wear, thermal and alignment variation are not validated.

limits: Published wire data do not qualify the final manufactured pin or spring; selected stock, temper, forming and processing must be verified
External loads and lever arms are illustrative and are not measured head or drop loads
Pin treated as an ideal cantilever with a resultant at the engagement midpoint; bearing distributions and support flexibility omitted
Combining maximum beam bending and shear is a conservative nominal envelope, not a resolved stress field or bearing contact peak
Spring uses a Wahl-corrected elastic coil equation; no fatigue, set, buckling, friction, end-seat or rubbing calculation
Spring bodies in CAD reserve the envelope, not actual wire end geometry
Return force must exceed measured friction; it is not known that this spring reliably engages
No physical strength, lifetime, drop or wearer-safety pass
